purpose: Generated visual references. Previously displayed model sheet saved alongside the missing single battle sprite; no live game art changed.
limitations: Generated enlarged pixel-style reference; exact 120px height, 30–35 color palette and uniform native pixel grid unverified.
sprite_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE beautifully finished full-body game battle sprite of the EXACT mechanical SHOEBILL bird in the attached current eight-view sprite sheet. Image 1 is the sole authoritative machine design reference. GBA Zoids Legacy battle sprite style, faithful to the user's design. Single bird FACING RIGHT, camera approximately 18 degrees above ground and turned 20 degrees toward viewer from side profile. Entire bill, crest, folded wings, swept feather blades, both legs and all feet visible with generous margins. Neutral planted two-foot stance. One thin straight VIOLET ground line beneath feet. Flat uniform neutral medium grey background, no gradient or vignette, text, logos, labels, borders, multiple views or scenery.

Deliberate pixel art: native design about 120 logical pixels tall, shown enlarged nearest-neighbor with crisp pixel edges. Target 30–35 colors in long material ramps, upper-left light, orderly precise pixel clusters, readable broad plate faces, restrained metal edge glints. Outlines darker shades of each part's own material color, NEVER pure black. No antialiasing, blurry painting, photorealism, smooth 3D rendering or texture noise.

Preserve exact current shoebill: very large broad GOLD/YELLOW armored shoebill bill, flattened shoe-like upper bill with angular panel seams, a pronounced down-hooked gold end with small dark blue terminal tip; tiny flat CYAN eyes, small swept blue crown crest and tall segmented blue mechanical neck. Rounded pale STEEL BLUE breast plate with small dark vertical inset at bottom. Folded layered wings, steel/ice-blue lit armor faces, navy inner plates and seams, GOLD circular shoulder pivots. Long narrow pointed BLUE METAL FEATHER BLADES swept BACK AND DOWN along the rear body, close to folded wings; short layered tail fan behind. Pale blue hip/thigh armor integrated in lower body, gold hip/knee/ankle fittings, long VERY SLENDER dark grey articulated bird legs, broad splayed grey mechanical toes with GOLD tips and a rear toe. Match original reference body proportions, beak shape, leg joint positions and feather arrangement rather than adding details. No rifle above head, cannons, invented weapons, new wings, organic feathers/skin, extra limbs or redesign. Cyan eyes are flat color, NO glow, bloom, aura or light spill. A highly polished faithful handheld-game sprite reference matching the other machines in this series.
